verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MWENNA muyimuke,
Ng'abasserikale;
Mwambale-eby'okulwanyisa
Byonna-ebya Katonda.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mubeere ba maanyi,
Mumutunuulire;
Ye ge maanyi gaffe gonna,
Agatuwanguza.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Temutya mulabe,
Yesu yawangula;
Amaanyi gonna-ag'okufa
Tegakyasobola.

verse.name: v4
v5
verse.lines:
Mwesibe-amazima,
N'obutuukirivu;
Nga mutunuulira Yesu,
Omukulembeze.
